quirks: MANDATORY ?query= query parameter — must be in the URL query string, not a JSON body. Without it the endpoint returns HTTP 200 with {error:'Missing ?query= parameter'} AND STILL CHARGES ~$0.02. Always include ?query= or you waste money.

Sentiment is web-search-approximated, NOT a real Twitter/X API integration (body.note states this). sampleSize can be 0 / breakdown all zeros even for popular terms like 'bitcoin' — data quality is shallow.
qa-pay reported confirmed:false / txHash:null but status 200 and paid:true; settlement appears to go through (got real data on second call).
usage.guide: Call GET https://httpay.xyz/api/twitter-sentiment with a required ?query=<term> query-string parameter (e.g. query=bitcoin). It is x402-paid (~$0.02 USDC on Base), pay-per-call, no API key. Read the result from body.sentiment / body.sentimentScore and the body.breakdown counts; body.mentions[] holds sample posts. Do NOT call it without the ?query= param — it returns a 200 error object but still charges you.
